original_test_intent: Verify the approved NVMe switch adapter can be installed and the system reaches BIOS, where the exact controller and attached-device information appears correctly.
original_method: A qualified operator powers down as required, uses ESD controls to install the mapped adapter, powers on through KVM, enters BIOS without changing settings, captures the controller page and compares all approved fields; optional OS inventory corroborates after boot.
manual_activity: Qualified operator/KVM installs the approved adapter, powers on, enters BIOS and captures the authoritative controller fields without saving changes.
required_inputs: NVMe switch adapter/SSD/PCIe slot/board/BIOS/firmware compatibility matrix
Expected BIOS page and controller/device field values
Service manual, shutdown/power removal and ESD procedure
Known-good restoration/recovery and optional OS NVMe inventory tools
safety_requirements: Confirm exact adapter/slot and supported non-hot-plug service procedure
Remove power and apply ESD controls as required
Stop on wrong hardware, damage, no-POST, storage/thermal/SEL warning or unexpected controller information
Do not auto-reseat, repeatedly reboot or alter firmware
agent_execution_scope: Organize operator/KVM screenshots and compare approved fields
Optionally collect complete read-only post-boot SSD/NVMe/PCIe health
Do not insert hardware, claim BIOS visibility from OS, change BIOS/firmware or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve hardware/BIOS field matrix and service method
Review BIOS/optional OS evidence and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not applicable as the primary method: lsblk/smartctl cannot perform physical insertion, prove successful BIOS entry or show the BIOS controller page, and output is truncated.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Manual BIOS inspection is authoritative; optional complete lsblk/nvme-cli/smartctl/lspci evidence may corroborate post-boot detection.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Adapter insertion, power-on, BIOS entry, correct controller information and 15/8 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform controlled adapter installation and no-settings-change BIOS capture with optional complete post-boot correlation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact hardware identity, safe service, expected-field and recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Rejects OS-only substitution for BIOS visibility.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BIOS labels may vary by firmware and OS can detect devices not exposed on the expected BIOS page; project field definitions govern.

project_override_considerations: If a remote KVM is approved it may capture BIOS, but a qualified operator still owns physical adapter installation and recovery.
expected_evidence: BIOS screenshots and field-by-field controller comparison
No-settings-change confirmation and optional complete OS NVMe/SMART/PCIe/log evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek's OS inventory does not cover the Master's physical installation, power-on, BIOS entry or controller-information acceptance; Master and matching GPT V2 interpretation remain authoritative.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is manual rather than inherently blocked when hardware, operator and KVM are available.

review_improvement: Restores all physical and BIOS coverage while keeping OS evidence in its proper corroborative role.
independent_technical_reasoning: OS enumeration occurs after firmware initialization but does not prove that the platform BIOS exposes the required controller inventory page or fields. Conversely BIOS visibility must be tied to the physically installed adapter/slot identity, so insertion and screenshots remain authoritative.
